name: What are some common property maintenance issues in the desert climate of Southern Nevada?

mainEntity.name: What are some common property maintenance issues in the desert climate of Southern Nevada?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the desert climate of Southern Nevada, common property maintenance issues include HVAC system strain due to extreme heat, leading to higher energy consumption and wear. Sun exposure can damage roofing materials, exterior paint, and landscaping features like irrigation systems. Pest control is also a frequent concern. Regular inspections and maintenance tailored to desert conditions are essential to mitigate these specific challenges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common maintenance issues in Southern Nevada's desert climate include HVAC strain, sun damage to exteriors, and pest control. Regular, tailored maintenance is crucial.
